column1: # Cross-platform fixture set (XP-01 to XP-03). tests/xp/build.sh compiles each line natively on Linux, records what the
# native build prints and returns, and compiles the same sources in portable mode; tests/xp/run.sh reproduces the native
# result on any .NET host. Fixtures here must not depend on the host: no host paths, time zones, locales, permission
# bits or process identity in their output (docs/dev/host-abi.md lists what differs between hosts).
